en: A vintage black and white postcard depicting an ornate, historical interior room with high ceilings, large windows with curtains, classical wooden furniture, a chandelier, and a collection of portraits on the wall. In the center, there is a glass display case. The architectural style suggests academia or a formal institution. The border of the postcard contains printed text indicating location and the publisher.
